cases.sentence: …когда Господь говорил с Моисеем на ___ Синай.
cases.translation: …when the Lord spoke with Moses on Mount Sinai.
cases.explain: The preposition на marking location takes the prepositional → горе.

cases.sentence: Приведи род Левия и представь их ___ Аарону.
cases.translation: Bring the tribe of Levi and present them to Aaron the priest.
cases.explain: Священник is the indirect object of представь (present to) → dative.

cases.sentence: Вот ___ Аарона и Моисея к тому времени, когда Господь говорил с Моисеем.
cases.translation: This is the genealogy of Aaron and Moses at the time the Lord spoke with Moses.
cases.explain: Родословие is the subject of the sentence → nominative.

cases.sentence: Когда я умертвил всех первенцев в ___, я отделил себе всех первенцев в Израиле.
cases.translation: When I struck down all the firstborn in Egypt, I set apart for myself all the firstborn in Israel.
cases.explain: The preposition в marking location takes the prepositional → Египте.

cases.sentence: Имена ___ Аарона: Надав его первенец, Авиуд, Элиазар и Итамар.
cases.translation: The names of the sons of Aaron: Nadab his firstborn, Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.
cases.explain: Имена (names of) governs the genitive of possession → сыновей.

cases.sentence: Главным ___ левитов был Элиазар, сын священника Аарона.
cases.translation: The chief leader of the Levites was Eleazar, son of Aaron the priest.
cases.explain: The predicate noun after был (was) takes the instrumental → вождём.

cases.sentence: Отдай ___ за выкуп излишка Аарону и его сыновьям.
cases.translation: Give the silver for the redemption of the surplus to Aaron and his sons.
cases.explain: Серебро is the direct object of отдай (give) → accusative; a neuter noun's accusative equals the nominative.

cases.sentence: Моисей отдал ___ Аарону и его сыновьям по слову Господа.
cases.translation: Moses gave the redemption money to Aaron and his sons, according to the word of the Lord.
cases.explain: Выкуп is the direct object of отдал (gave) → accusative; inanimate masculine acc equals the nominative.

reading.ru: Но Надав и Авиуд умерли перед Господом, когда принесли ему чуждый огонь в Синайской пустыне.
reading.question: Why did Nadab and Abihu die before the Lord?
options: They offered strange fire before the Lord
reading.correct: They offered strange fire before the Lord
reading.explain: The text says they died when they offered strange fire before the Lord in the wilderness of Sinai.

reading.ru: Левиты мои, потому что все первенцы мои.
reading.question: Why does God say the Levites are His?
options: Because all the firstborn are His
reading.correct: Because all the firstborn are His
reading.explain: God claims the Levites because all the firstborn belong to Him.

reading.ru: Всего левитов, которых Моисей и Аарон исчислили по повелению Господа, по их семьям, всех мужчин возрастом от месяца и старше, было 22 тысячи человек.
reading.question: How many Levite males (a month old and up) were counted in total?
reading.explain: The text gives the total of the Levites as twenty-two thousand.

reading.ru: Кланы Гершонитов должны были ставить лагерь на западе, позади Скинии.
reading.question: Where were the clans of the Gershonites to camp?
options: On the west, behind the tabernacle
reading.correct: On the west, behind the tabernacle
reading.explain: The text places the Gershonite clans on the west, behind the tabernacle.

reading.question: What was entrusted to the care of the Kohathites?
reading.explain: The text says the sanctuary was entrusted to the care of the Kohathites.

reading.ru: Моисей отдал выкуп Аарону и его сыновьям по слову Господа, как ему повелел Господь.
reading.question: To whom did Moses give the redemption money?
reading.explain: The text says Moses gave the redemption money to Aaron and his sons.
